title: Hot-wallet drain
summary: A declared hot wallet changed code or delegation, broke a declared limit, or sent to a destination the operator has not listed.
lesson: L8 signing path is part of the key
breaks_link: actions on objectives, by an issuer freeze request and by the operator's own limit cut. Sentinel does not construct the transaction.

steps.text: Confirm on a second channel. Do not trust a chat message alone, including a message that claims to be Sentinel.
steps.lesson: L9 freezes thaw and are verified out of band

steps.text: Do not sign, delegate, or approve anything from the hot path while this playbook is open. Sentinel will not sign either.
steps.lesson: L8 signing path is part of the key

steps.text: Treat a code or delegation change on a declared hot wallet as tier-0. Page the human commander.
steps.lesson: L8 signing path is part of the key

steps.text: Use your own ceremony to cut limits and move any remaining hot balance. Sentinel lists the step. It does not build the transaction.
steps.lesson: L8 signing path is part of the key

steps.text: Review issuer freeze drafts. Addresses, amounts, and tx hashes are filled from the alert. You send them on the issuer's published channel.
steps.lesson: L9 freezes thaw and are verified out of band

steps.text: Review counterparty drafts for lending markets, bridges, and exchanges you actually use.
Review the IC3 draft and the SEAL 911 contact note. You send them.
Walk the pre-authorization ledger. Revoke outstanding delegations and allowances through your own process.
steps.lesson: L8 signing path is part of the key

thaw: Issuer clocks are recorded per asset, including assets that have no freeze function.
Outstanding delegations on the declared wallet are cleared or re-approved in writing.
Signer and policy rotation is a change card, not a Sentinel transaction.
Root-cause card cites what is known and what is still unproven.
